dispositions.rationale: Swift-local shorthand inside inflateSingleGzipMember that wraps a rejection reason in Result.failure. The Kotlin twin returns InflationResult.Invalid inline, so no Kotlin declaration exists to pair.

Hand-rolled raw-DEFLATE decoder (RFC 1951): WhoopProtocol builds on Linux without dependencies and Foundation offers no inflate there. The Kotlin twin FirmwareImageParser.inflateSingleGzipMember delegates to java.util.zip.Inflater, so no Kotlin declaration exists to pair.
